token = apis.spotify.login(username='la-mcco@gmail.com', password=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

# 1) Fetch ALL songs in library
page_limit=20
library_songs=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=token, page_index=i, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    library_songs.extend(page)
    i+=1

# 2) Determine which library songs are released in/before 2021
songs_to_remove_from_library=[]
for s in library_songs:
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=s['song_id'])
    release_date = details.get('release_date')
    year = int(release_date[:4]) if release_date else None
    if year is not None and year<=2021:
        songs_to_remove_from_library.append({
            'song_id': s['song_id'],
            'title': s['title'],
            'release_date': release_date,
            'year': year
        })

# 3) Fetch ALL playlists in playlist library (both public/private)
playlists=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    playlists.extend(page)
    i+=1

# 4) Determine which songs inside those playlists are released in/before 2021
#    (even if they are not in your song library)
# Build playlist_id -> song_ids list
playlist_song_map = {p['playlist_id']: list(p.get('song_ids', [])) for p in playlists}
all_playlist_song_ids = sorted({sid for sids in playlist_song_map.values() for sid in sids})

release_year_by_song_id = {}
for sid in all_playlist_song_ids:
    details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date = details.get('release_date')
    year = int(release_date[:4]) if release_date else None
    release_year_by_song_id[sid] = {'release_date': release_date, 'year': year}

songs_to_remove_from_playlists = {}
for pid, sids in playlist_song_map.items():
    to_remove=[]
    for sid in sids:
        info = release_year_by_song_id.get(sid, {})
        if info.get('year') is not None and info.get('year')<=2021:
            to_remove.append(sid)
    if to_remove:
        songs_to_remove_from_playlists[pid]=to_remove

print('library_songs_count', len(library_songs))

print('songs_to_remove_from_library_ids', [x['song_id'] for x in songs_to_remove_from_library])

print('playlists_count', len(playlists))
print('playlists_with_qualifying_songs', len(songs_to_remove_from_playlists))

token = apis.spotify.login(username='la-mcco@gmail.com', password=[a['password'] for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if a['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']

playlist_ids = [8,9,10,11,12,13]

    8: [99,159,177],
    9: [18,41,301,315,317],
    10:[17,18,107,110,119,167],
    11:[137,138,162,320],
    12:[33,133,226],
    13:[94,96,127,272,301]
}

# Fetch show_playlist details to confirm each qualifying song is present before deletion
for pid in playlist_ids:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=token)
    song_ids_in_pl = [s['id'] for s in pl.get('songs', [])]
    missing = [sid for sid in qualifying_by_playlist[pid] if sid not in song_ids_in_pl]
    print('playlist', pid, '| title:', pl.get('title'), '| songs_count:', len(song_ids_in_pl), '| missing_qualifying:', missing)
    # print song titles for missing/first 3
    present = [sid for sid in qualifying_by_playlist[pid] if sid in song_ids_in_pl]
